report_md:
# Breakeven inflation — report

**Dev:** 31.23% CAGR / 60.28% DD / 0.87 Sharpe.  
**Full:** 19.67% CAGR / 74.96% DD / 0.65 Sharpe; 557 full fills.  
**2024-2026 holdout:** -7.88% CAGR / 65.62% DD / 0.00 Sharpe.

## Rules

When inflation compensation is rising (TIP/IEF 10-session change in its top half), easier real rates support TQQQ; otherwise BIL.

## Why it is distinct

The primary object is TIP/IEF inflation compensation, not oil, energy or credit. It replaces the oil-shock family, which had 0.80 raw correlation. Maximum signal Jaccard against the nine existing winners is 0.48 and maximum raw correlation is 0.60.

## Caveats

- Full CAGR is below the TQQQ bar; this is an active research family, not a winner.
- The 2024-2026 holdout is reported exactly as run; it is not used to tune parameters.
- External daily series are committed under `data/external/`.
hypothesis_md:
# Breakeven inflation

**Slug:** `family-breakeven`  
**Family:** breakeven  
**Primary object:** TIP/IEF 10-session inflation-compensation impulse  
**Window:** 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29 development; full holdout 2024-01-02..2026-10-23.

## Claim

When inflation compensation is rising (TIP/IEF 10-session change in its top half), easier real rates support TQQQ; otherwise BIL.

## Rules

- Signal uses the external daily series through the prior session; it is lagged one session.
- Target is written at the session close and filled at the next QQQ/TQQQ open.
- Long-only TQQQ/BIL, weights >=0, sum <=1, 2% band, 1 bp headline.
- 252-session percentile rank with a 0.45/0.55 deadband.
- No price-trend, realised-vol, calendar, opening-range, ML or risk-sizing gate.

## Falsifiers

- Full CAGR <=5% or fewer than 100 full fills (or 30 events).
- Signal Jaccard >0.70 against an existing winner.
- Raw daily-return correlation >0.70 against an existing winner.

## Caveat

The primary object is TIP/IEF inflation compensation, not oil, energy or credit. It replaces the oil-shock family, which had 0.80 raw correlation.
